title: Sneaky

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Sneaky is a status effect granted by wearing all four pieces of the Troll armor set. It increases Sneak skill by 15 but does not exceed the skill cap of 100.

full_text:
Sneaky

Effects: Sneak +15

Introduction. Sneaky is a status effect granted by wearing all four pieces of the Troll armor set. It increases Sneak skill by 15 but does not exceed the skill cap of 100.
